INTERACTIVE TEXTBOOK · SAXONY

A maths book that calculates with you

Colour in a hundred square and see that $25\%$ is a quarter. Move capital, interest rate and days and read off how much interest a savings account earns in three months. Walk below zero on the number line, and bend a square into a tile like M. C. Escher’s that still fills the plane without gaps. Plus exercises at three levels, self-checks with instant feedback and examples from shopping, the bank, the weather and everyday life.

9 CHAPTERS 100 LESSONS + ELECTIVE SAXON CURRICULUM

CONTENTSIN THE ORDER OF THE SCHOOL YEAR

The chapters follow the teaching plan of Year 7 on the intermediate track: first percentages and interest (learning area 1) from the convenient percentages via the three basic problems to discounts, VAT and compound interest, then chance and frequencies (learning area 2), rational numbers, terms and equations (learning area 3) and polygons and prisms with area, volume and density (learning area 4). The elective area leads to tilings. On the right you can see when each chapter is due and how many self-checks you have already solved.

HOW TO USE THIS BOOK
EVERY CHAPTER HAS THE SAME STRUCTURE
  1. Opener with learning goals and a check-in: what you should already be able to do.
  2. Explorations: open questions to try out, ideally in groups.
  3. Units: starter, explanation, key-point box, examples, interactive elements, exercises and “Test yourself!”.
  4. Review · Deepen · Connect: mixed exercises.
  5. Excursion: history, an application or a nice puzzle.
  6. Looking back on one page and a test with two rounds.
THE SYMBOLS

Basic   Intermediate   Advanced

Every exercise has the solution to fold out. Try it yourself first.

In the self-checks you type in your result. Fractions ($3/10$), decimals ($0.3$) and percentages ($30\%$) are all understood. Your browser remembers what you have solved.

Where you should use a calculator, the exercise says so. Round 1 of every test is without a calculator; everything else can mostly be done with your head and a pen.

Labs open in a new tab. There you can experiment for longer and more freely than in the book. The labs and the weekly exercise sheets are in German for now.

KEY POINT

Whatever is in an orange box, you need to know. Everything else helps you to understand it.
